issues: Grid is md:grid-cols-5 but has 6 fields for monthly projects, so 'Service Period To' wraps alone onto a second row, separated from 'Service Period From'. Consider grid-cols-6 or grouping From/To together.
Amber month-taken note is long and stretches the Billing Month column height

action_items: Optional: keep Service Period From/To on same row (layout tweak) in BillRequests.jsx create dialog
Optional: guard RaBills fromRequest useEffect to avoid duplicate toast
critical_code_review_comments: BillRequests.jsx: pickMonth always overwrites period_from/to with month bounds — intended, but a user who edited a custom period then touches the month input loses edits silently (acceptable per spec).
Generated RA bill does not carry period_from/period_to — matches user choice (3), just noting.
No delete endpoint for bill requests, so test records cannot be cleaned via API.
